enforcement.before: A new installation starts without an active integration. An existing installation may expose a different contract.
enforcement.after: The root-first controller directs the runtime to the shared workspace view, verifies both mandatory texts at its head and routes technical adoption independently from organizational knowledge work.
enforcement.rationale: An initial installation requires its own compatible declarative adapter. Reuse an observed current complete-context forwarding adapter when its documented limits and actual administrative prerequisites remain valid; reconcile only owned incompatible state. No predecessor release or peer adoption is asserted.
enforcement.already_satisfied: Owned adapter readers accept the current interface and actual administrative receipts remain valid; SHA/status alone is insufficient.
enforcement.recovery: Inspect actual active configuration and journal phase under an exclusive owned lock; preserve verified active on staging failure; reconcile activated_pending_checkpoint before advancement. Never remove ongoing/recovery code or advance peer adoption.
enforcement.retention: one active plus at most one ordinary transient candidate; preserve referenced historical evidence explicitly inactive

adapter_reconciliation.assurance: Current observed-state reconciliation, not a predecessor release claim or consumer functional certification.

enforcement.target_commit: Resolve containing OOP version control commit after publication; never a future self-SHA.

target_identity: Resolve obtained canonical repository/ref/full commit metadata; no future self-SHA.

common.rationale: The initial distribution has no predecessor; common installation and actual-state reconciliation remain independently required under current authority.

runtime.rationale: The initial distribution has no predecessor; runtime installation and actual-state reconciliation remain independently required under current authority.

operations.rationale: The initial distribution has no predecessor; operations installation and actual-state reconciliation remain independently required under current authority.

unknown: Missing required descriptor/facts is UNKNOWN, never no-op.
